name: Directory replacement snapshots
description: Tracked directories replaced by existing or dangling symlinks snapshot correctly both staged and unstaged, preserving the index and rejecting attempts to read through the link.

passage.quote: Selection of a directory is expanded into its changed files before preparation proceeds. Existing review records cannot be changed or removed through a parent directory; the only review written by preparation is its own generated record. Selecting a parent covers its descendants, so a tracked directory replaced by a symlink is captured as one replacement. Selecting a descendant through that symlink alone remains invalid.
